title: 小小英文新鲜事 - 1017 | 新恐龙命名、小熊猫起名、火星取土
description:
🎧 本期音频为全英文，适合有一定英语基础的小朋友。

👧 今天 Mia 和 Lina 聊了三个新鲜事：

🦖 英国博物馆里躺了 100 年的一块恐龙头骨，终于被确认为全新物种，名字叫“不败女战士”！
🐾 华盛顿动物园的小熊猫宝宝要起名字啦，三个候选名 Pyra、Dolpa、Dolly，你投哪一个？
🚀 日本 MMX 探测器周一发射，去火星的月亮 Phobos 上“吹”一勺土带回地球，快递要走五年！

📖 Word of the day: discovery（发现）

🎮 猜谜时间：100 亿年前咆哮过、长着巨爪、现在骨头睡在博物馆里——我是谁？

---
🇬🇧 In today's episode:

🦖 A dinosaur skull that sat in a British museum for 100 years turned out to be a brand new species named "the unconquered female warrior"!
🐾 A baby red panda at the Washington DC zoo needs a name — Pyra, Dolpa, or Dolly? Which would you pick?
🚀 Japan's MMX spacecraft launches Monday to the Martian moon Phobos, puffs gas to scoop up moon dust, and brings it home in 2031!

📖 Word of the day: discovery

🎮 Riddle time: I roared 100 million years ago, had giant claws, and now my bones sleep in a museum — who am I?

📝 生词本 Words to learn

1. discovery（发现）
when you find something brand new that nobody knew before
例：a new dinosaur discovery（恐龙新发现）

2. warrior（战士）
a brave fighter
例：a female warrior（女战士）

3. sample（样品）
a tiny piece of something to study
例：a small sample（一小份样品）

4. vote（投票）
to choose something by voting
例：vote for a name（为名字投票）
